Take a look the expanded equation at docs#CategoryTheory.Functor.fromPUnit

CategoryTheory.Functor.fromPUnit X = (CategoryTheory.Functor.const (CategoryTheory.Discrete PUnit.{?u.3 + 1})).obj X

What's going on here?
In the declaration's type, we have a free universe for the PUnit: Discrete PUnit.{w + 1}. But shouldn't that appear in the equation as well?
Yeah this was discussed already here: #mathlib4 > Docs incorrectly displaying universes
